item.title: El Fire TV se vuelve mucho más útil en España: ahora también permite jugar a Amazon Luna a través de Prime Video
item.description: Poco a poco, Amazon va integrando más funciones útiles a sus dispositivos Fire TV Stick , sobre todo a los de las generaciones más actuales. Más allá de ser un reproductor de contenido de cine y series, ahora también lo es para gaming gracias al paso que ha dado: integrar Amazon Luna en sus Fire TV Stick a través de Prime Video . Fire TV Stick 4K Plus Hoy en Amazon — 84,99 € El precio podría variar. Obtenemos comisión por estos enlaces Todo desde una sola app Amazon Luna es el servicio de videojuegos de Amazon, similar a Game Pass, aunque salvando las grandes distancias. Lo que ofrece Amazon… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Tom Cruise’s Digger is a commercial flop – but also the perfect climate film for our time
item.description: The movie follows Digger Rockwell, whose drilling triggers a vast iceberg that’s five times the size of Washington DC Digger, the new Alejandro González Iñárritu film, is bombastic, misanthropic and an epic, critically savaged flop. It is also the near-perfect climate change film for our era. Digger Rockwell, the eponymous protagonist played by Tom Cruise, is a bluntly caricatured Texas oilman blase about the environmental ruin of his drilling, even as it triggers a disastrous splitting of the Arctic ice sheet. This causes a vast iceberg, five times the size of Washington DC, to barrel… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: Qing dynasty bowl with bats and peaches sells for $2.048 million after 87 years in a Chicago museum
item.description: A stunning porcelain bowl from the Qing dynasty recently fetched $2.048 million at a Christie's auction. Crafted during Emperor Yongzheng's reign, the bowl is adorned with auspicious symbols, hinting it was a birthday gift for the emperor. After decades in the Art Institute of Chicago, the proceeds will fund new acquisitions and conservation efforts. This sale is part of a lucrative two-day auction dedicated to Chinese art. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Oh God, I can’t bear it’: Judi Dench says Cats film was ‘a waste of goodwill and talent’
item.description: The actor’s forthcoming memoir Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It? says the makers had honourable intentions but the elements ‘didn’t coalesce’ Dame Judi Dench has long made her feelings clear about Cats, the doomed 2019 adaptation of the Andrew Lloyd Webber musical. In an interview the year after release, she said she had so far declined to watch the movie – in which she played wise moggy Old Deuteronomy – and described the orange fur coat she had to wear as looking like “five foxes fucking on my back”. In her forthcoming memoir, Is It Too Late to Make a Run for It? Dench reflects further… Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Catherine Shoard

item.title: Ibai le alquila a Netflix su noche más vista: La Velada del Año será exclusiva de la plataforma hasta 2029
item.description: Netflix emitirá en directo y en exclusiva las ediciones de 2027, 2028 y 2029 de La Velada del Año, según un comunicado de la propia plataforma . La séptima edición será la primera que no se retransmita en el canal de Twitch de Ibai Llanos, su casa desde 2021. Kick le ofreció el triple, según ha contado el propio streamer, pero lo cierto es que nos quedamos sin saber ningún detalle económico jugoso de esta nueva vida para el evento que arrancó en 2021 en una sala de conciertos de Barcelona. Nueve millones de pantallas. La Velada tiene un formato con el crecimiento ya garantizado, aúnque ahora… Fuente: Xataka.
item.dc:creator: John Tones

item.title: ‘Unguarded moments’: a lost archive of street photography – in pictures
item.description: Little-known photographer John Baer captured everyday life before putting down his camera in 1954. His son discovered the images decades later after his death, and John Baer: The Extraordinary Ordinary / A Memoir in Photographs, 1945–1954 marks their first public release Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.

item.title: 46 reacciones · 24 comentarios | Protesters in France, including students from art and culture schools, blocked the entrances to the Louvre Museum in Paris on Monday as part of a wider wave of demonstrations across the country. Hundreds of protesters gathered outside the museum in support of the student movement that began more than a month ago over poor school conditions. The action led to tense exchanges with some tourists, frustrated by the disruption to their visits. French authorities imposed localized curfews on Monday as the country reeled from a weekend of violence. | CBS News
